interpretation: Complete actual prefill rows refine the earlier terminal-row observation. Layer0 input and post-attention normalized matrices are bit-exact for both q5 and q85; the original BF16 residual entering MoE is also exact. Layer0 MoE combined BF16 carrier differs at2926/10240 values for q5 and88/174080 for q85. Both terminal rows happen to match. Earlier rows therefore already differ at layer1 input and propagate through its recurrence into the terminal row. The defect is localized to layer0 MoE output before cross-layer consumption; later GDN differences alone are not the origin. Original output/logit failures independently reject the product. These copies preserve the native outputs and reproduce both reference outputs; raw intermediate hashes are diagnostics only. Completed MoE projection observations are recorded separately in http-short-moe-projections-20260912.json.
